import csv
target_date = "2018-04-11"
zone_ids = {
 "7f297e37-40eb-5a74-a1ce-c242bf4b26aa",
 "14c164b8-1957-5aa7-961c-a3ad951900da",
 "1b318110-05c1-54b3-8fea-315f5900b64a",
 "1689d963-4d6f-57dc-8368-b7b6ce076ca4",
 "1b3eb9e6-d753-5328-bf35-516ad86dafc4",
}
building_id = "43017c43-0ad2-5eef-8e41-95a8780d3143"

lighting_J = 0.0
building_J = 0.0
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    r = csv.DictReader(f)
    for row in r:
        ts = row['timestamp']
        if not ts.startswith(target_date):
            continue
        sid = row['timeseries_id']
        v = float(row['value'])
        if sid in zone_ids:
            lighting_J += v * 3600.0
        elif sid == building_id:
            building_J += v

print("lighting J:", lighting_J)
print("building J:", building_J)
print("fraction:", lighting_J / building_J)
